prevents unknown third-party tools from injecting themselves in the game. This protection can be disabled, which allows the use of said tools. {{ii}} Online play will be disabled when Easy Anti-Cheat is disabled. {{Fixbox|description=Use [https://www.nexusmods.com/eldenringnightreign/mods/46 Elden Ring Nightreign EAC Toggler]|ref={{Refcheck|user=SargeCassidy|date=2025-06-05|comment=}}|fix= '''Notes''' {{++}} This tool will make {{file|start_protected_game.exe}} launch {{file|nightreign.exe}}, so the latest game version will always be used and Easy Anti-Cheat will be disabled no matter how the game is launched. }} {{Fixbox|description=Run through {{file|nightreign.exe}}|ref={{Refcheck|user=SargeCassidy|date=2025-05-31|comment=}}|fix= # Go to {{folder|{{p|game}}\Game\}}. # Create {{file|steam_appid.txt}} and write {{code|2622380}} inside the file. Don't forget to save it. # Run the game through {{file|nightreign.exe}}. It will launch directly and still have full integration with Steam. '''Notes''' {{ii}} Deleting or renaming {{file|start_protected_game.exe}} located in {{folder|{{p|game}}\Game\}} and then renaming {{file|nightreign.exe}} to {{file|start_protected_game.exe}}, allows the game to be directly launched through Steam. {{ii}} Optionally, add {{file|nightreign.exe}} as a non-Steam game or create a shortcut on the desktop. }} ==Modifications== {{ii}} The anti-cheat must be disabled for most mods to load; see [[#Easy Anti-Cheat|Easy Anti-Cheat]]. ===General=== ====[https://www.nexusmods.com/eldenringnightreign/mods/30 Fast Launch]==== {{ii}} Can be used together with [https://www.nexusmods.com/eldenringnightreign/mods/71 Disable White Startup Screen] to remove all intro videos. ===Graphics=== ====[https://www.patreon.com/posts/130329024 Disable Chromatic Aberration]==== ====[https://www.patreon.com/posts/130271114 Disable Sharpen]==== ====[https://www.nexusmods.com/eldenringnightreign/mods/69 Disable Vignette]==== ===Performance=== ====[https://www.nexusmods.com/eldenringnightreign/mods/17 Performance Boost for Potato PC]==== {{ii}} Back up {{file|regulation.bin}} before replacing it. {{ii}} Allows disabling grass, shadows or both. ==System requirements== {{System requirements |OSfamily = Windows |minOS = 10 |minCPU = Intel Core i5 10600 |minCPU2 = AMD Ryzen 5 5500 |minRAM = 12 GB |minHD = 30 GB |minGPU = Nvidia GeForce GTX 1060 |minGPU2 = AMD Radeon RX 580 |minVRAM = 3 GB (Nvidia), 4 GB (AMD) |minDX = 12 |recOS = 11 |recCPU = Intel Core i5 11500 |recCPU2 = AMD Ryzen 5 5600 |recRAM = 16 GB |recHD = |recGPU = Nvidia GeForce GTX 1070 |recGPU2 = AMD Radeon RX Vega 56 |recVRAM = 8 GB |recDX = |notes = }} {{References}}
